old_caption: The video captures a serene sunset over a landscape dominated by a sea of clouds. The sky is painted with hues of orange and yellow near the horizon, gradually transitioning into a darker blue as it stretches upwards. The sun, partially obscured by clouds, casts a warm glow across the scene. Below, a layer of clouds appears to ripple and flow like waves, creating a mesmerizing effect. In the foreground, silhouettes of trees and a fence line are visible, adding depth to the composition. The overall atmosphere is tranquil, with the gentle movement of the clouds enhancing the peaceful ambiance. There are no animals or characters present; the focus remains on the natural beauty of the landscape and the dynamic interplay between light and shadow. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, allowing viewers to fully absorb the tranquil and captivating view.

caption: The video captures a wide landscape at sunset, with an orange sky and a bright sun glow partly hidden behind a dark, snow-flecked mountain ridge. A thick, undulating sea of low clouds fills the valley below the ridge, its rippled surface shifting almost imperceptibly. In the near foreground, dark silhouetted leafless bushes sit at the bottom-left, while a thin fence line runs along the very bottom edge. The overall composition, lighting and color balance remain essentially constant throughout the excerpt. The dark cloud band crossing the sun glow drifts with only very slow, gentle motion. No object enters or exits the frame, and the foreground bushes and fence hold their positions unchanged. There is no detectable camera pan, tilt, zoom or translation. The mountain ridge and the protruding dark hill on the right stay fixed in the same positions throughout.
